transcript.text: Good morning everyone. Before I publish the final outage calendar, I need to hear from both the facilities and signal leads on any current constraints. As we know, the water treatment plant and communications annex both require preventive maintenance over the next two workdays, and we only have one crew available — so the two outages cannot overlap. Please share anything that affects scheduling on your end so I can sequence these properly.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a constraint on my end. I confirmed this morning that the water-treatment contractor is available only Tuesday from 0900 to 1100. During that outage, the plant must have a 600-gallon water-truck backup arranged. The contractor confirmation is in the facilities email but hasn't been entered on the battalion maintenance calendar yet.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag a constraint on the signal side. I confirmed that the communications annex UPS test must run Wednesday from 1300 to 1500, followed immediately at 1500 by a 30-minute generator-transfer test with the signal shop present. The vendor appointment is on the signal section's working schedule but hasn't been added to the battalion calendar yet.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: To summarize the facilities constraint: the water treatment plant outage is locked to Tuesday 0900–1100 with the contractor, and I need a 600-gallon water truck arranged as backup supply during that window. Since the comms annex UPS and generator tests are Wednesday afternoon, there's no overlap between the two outages, so both can be sequenced on the calendar as-is. Maj. Alvarez, I'd request that the calendar reflect the Tuesday water plant outage and that the 600-gallon water-truck support be formally assigned for that timeframe.
transcript.speaker: A2
